acceptance: Extension is approved and enabled, a private user session exists, and sync-status reports last_error null with pending_changes 0.
evidence: main 10cc2e8 already contained schema isolation. Extension linked, validated, trusted, and enabled with storage, managed-data, network, and background.

title: Issue one citation and read it from SQLite and Supabase
acceptance: issue-for-attendee creates a citation, sync-now leaves pending_changes 0, and the same id is present locally and in hosaka_citations.
evidence: issue-for-attendee created 7af8fc40-4aa4-4681-b993-e18440b91293 for API Probe Guest.

After sync-now, SQLite and REST hc_citations, hc_persons, and hc_remedies returned that citation, person, and remedy. Cloud sync_revision was 1. remote_cursor was 12. last_error null, pending_changes 0.

title: Record the failed interactive login and stuck sync lock
acceptance: A source note explains the HTTP 400 and busy lock without storing credentials.
evidence: auth-issues.md written in the citations checkout. It is untracked and was not pushed at this checkpoint.

Direct password grant with the stored secret returned HTTP 200. The interactive 400 was a different typed password, and the client hid the response body. Stopped PIDs 263154 and 263164 held the foreground lock until killed.

title: Prove the granted background loop uploads without sync-now
acceptance: With the Hosaka backend running and no manual sync-now, a newly issued citation reaches hosaka_citations within two minutes and sync-status shows last_error null and pending_changes 0.
evidence: Background worker pulled and pushed 21 citations through remote_cursor 203 with pending_changes 0 and last_error null.

evidence: Superseded by SUPABASE_READER_EMAIL and SUPABASE_READER_PASSWORD self-healing login in apps/hosted-wall/lib/supabase.js, verified live on https://citations.hosaka.xyz.
